# Zrimat

> Zrimat is the freelance web design, development and automation practice of Piyush Pareek in Bikaner, Rajasthan, India. It builds hand-coded business websites, lead capture and booking systems, WhatsApp automation and small ERP/CRM tools for local businesses. Standard business websites start at ₹6,999 (Starter) and ₹14,999 (Growth); e-commerce and ERP/CRM are quoted per project.

## Main pages
- [Home](https://zrimat.com/): services, pricing plans, FAQs and recent client work
- [Blog](https://zrimat.com/blog.html): guides for Bikaner business owners
